(WASTE AND SCRAP) PAPER OR PAPER BOARD
For the purposes of heading 4702, the expression "chemical wood pulp, dissolving grades"
means chemical wood pulp having by weight and insoluble fraction of 92% or more of soda
or sulphate wood pulp or of 88% or more for sulphite wood pulp after one hour in a caustic
soda solution containing 18% sodium hydroxide (NaOH) at 20oC, and for sulphite wood pulp
an ash content that does not exceed 0.15% by weight.
